name: 'Phite Club
description: Hassan has another job for you, it looks like it's time for the sands to shift in the Golden City...

name: A Christmas Reunion
description: Help Diango out with getting his workshop set up for production in the Christmas Village.

name: A Clockwork Syringe
description: Respond to an unconventional challenge by Rabid Jack's pirates and thwart their latest plan to rule the sea!

name: A Fairy Tale I - Growing Pains
description: Why are all the crops failing? Can you help the Group of Advanced Gardeners to save their precious farming patches from growing pains? Do green fingers help when faced with a six-foot tall gorse bush with a nasty temper?

name: A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen
description: The Fairy Queen should be awake and back in charge of the lost city, but why has the Fairy Godfather not abdicated the throne? What's happening to the inhabitants of Zanaris, and where is Fairy Nuff? Can you use the fairy rings to explore the planes and cure a queen?

name: A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift
description: The Fairy Queen is back to full health and her resistance movement is gathering momentum, but the Godfather (and his ever-growing ork army) aren't going to give up the throne without a fight. Defeating all those orks is going to be like pulling teeth.

name: A Shadow over Ashdale
description: Investigate the mysterious disappearance of Ashdale's residents.

name: A Soul's Bane
description: A rift has opened near the dig site, unleashing strange monsters. A sorrowful mother awaits her long-lost son at the top of the rift. Descend into the rift for an adventure teeming with twisted creatures born from the mind of a young boy driven to incarcerated madness.

name: A Tail of Two Cats
description: Missing: small black cat. Answers to the name of Bob. Last seen on the 19th of Bennath. Please contact Unferth in Burthorpe.

name: A Void Dance
description: Continue your hunt for the elusive escaped pests, and your investigations into how they came to escape.

name: Aftermath
description: Defeat Zamorak, and see what this means for Gielinor.

name: All Fired Up
description: King Roald has commissioned a beacon network to warn of threats from the Wilderness and Morytania. He seeks assistance to ensure its readiness in the event of emergency.

name: All Souls' Eve
description: Help Death and the Horsemen celebrate the spooky season!

name: Alpha vs Omega
description: Take the fight to Rasial in his citadel and save the City of Um.

name: Ancient Awakening
description: Embark on an expedition to Ungael and uncover Zemouregal's plan for Fort Forinthry.

name: Animal Magnetism
description: Professor Oddenstein has finally found a reliable assistant. Ava has no interest in megalomaniacal plans and scoffs at persecuting hapless minions. Her living arrangements are free of unusual furniture and strange pets. All she desires is a good night's sleep.

name: Another Slice of H.A.M.
description: The dwarves are building a new underground rail link between their city of Keldagrim and the cave goblins' Dorgesh-Kaan, but work is being held up by the discovery of ancient goblin artefacts, and they need the help of a qualified archaeologist. Helping them out should be simple enough — unless you stumble upon another H.A.M. plot against the city.

name: As a First Resort
description: After discovering health benefits in local springs, an enterprising human has convinced a primitive ogress tribe to transform their rustic camp into a spa. Before Oo'glog can open for business, you must ready the resort and remind the ogres that clubbing visitors is satisfying but not medicinal.

name: Azzanadra's Quest
description: Azzanadra needs our help to find the elder god eggs.

name: Back to my Roots
description: Use your Slayer skills to battle out of control vegetation with an attitude, cultivate your wits and stretch your Agility to solve a cunning maze - all to make a gardener's day. Do you have what it takes to cut this quest down to size?

name: Back to the Freezer
description: The penguins are back for another slippery tale of subterfuge and ramshackle science that'll leave you questioning the very fabric of reality...as well as the good taste of its puns. Can you circumvent the latest flashpoint in Gielinor's coldest war? There's only one way to find out.

name: Battle of Forinthry
description: Work with the Raptor to defend Fort Forinthry against an oncoming invasion.

name: Battle of the Monolith
description: The Monolith is under attack! Seren's forces need your help to defend it.

name: Beneath Cursed Tides
description: Discover the secrets behind the mysterious sinking of Tutorial Island.

name: Beneath Scabaras' Sands
description: Even after stopping Amascut's evil plan to corrupt the sacred Gate of Elidinis, there is still much work to be done. Her devourers are still roaming the desert, stealing the souls of the living. It is time to return to the harsh Kharidian desert as you delve [this quest] to search for the god that does not want to be found... before the Devourer can sink her claws into him!|{{UD|[this quest] Quest Launch - This Week In RuneScape

name: Between a Rock...
description: Hidden from trolls and Fremennik, the dwarves delve deep in search of ore. One dwarf has for years tried to crack open a seemingly impervious rock, believing it holds great wealth. Assist him, but take care you don't end up in a tight spot!

name: Big Chompy Bird Hunting
description: Rantz the ogre needs to feed his demanding children, Fycie and Bugs, so he wants to go [this quest]. Problem is, he's all fingers and thumbs when it comes to making ogre arrows. Give him a hand.

name: Biohazard
description: Assist Elena in uncovering the truth behind the Ardougne plague. Smuggle test samples across Kandarin to her former mentor.

name: Birthright of the Dwarves
description: Team up with Veldaban and take down the villainous Red Axe.

name: Blood Runs Deep
description: Delve into a stranger's dream and uncover a deadly new dagannoth threat.

name: Bringing Home the Bacon
description: Eli Bacon has discovered the secret of bacon following an accident involving his prized wrestling pig and a fire, and needs help ensuring there are enough pigs to sustain the expected popularity of his products.

name: Broken Home
description: A dangerous ghost is terrorising a mansion and needs to be put to rest.

name: Buyers and Cellars
description: Help establish a haven for the scoundrels and footpads of the land, and pull off some world-class heists to raise your roguish renown!

name: Cabin Fever
description: It's war on the high seas as Bill Teach attempts to sail from Port Phasmatys to the pirate enclave of Mos Le'Harmless. His crew has fled, so he seeks recruits eager to become a pirate and sink his enemy. Do you have what it takes to join his crew?

name: Call of the Ancestors
description: Aid the village of Kanatah and help the Goebies restore what was lost.

name: Carnillean Rising
description: Philipe - son of Sir Ceril - is somewhat of a brat. And by somewhat, Sir Ceril means quite a lot. Xenia doesn't want the job, so you'll have to do it. Teach Philipe the ways of being an adventurer in this create-your-own-quest quest.

name: Catapult Construction
description: The catapult guard at Tyras Camp is in trouble. His poor security and neglect have caused rot in the catapult. General Hining is furious. Replacement parts are delayed, and the engineer is missing. Fortunately, your Construction expertise makes you the ideal candidate to repair the catapult despite the complex, demanding task ahead.

name: Chef's Assistant
description: Help the Head Chef perfect a new recipe.

name: Children of Mah
description: Kharshai's in a sticky situation, but that's only the tip of the iceberg. The Mahjarrat are dying...and there's no way they're going quietly. Join the great and the mighty on an epic jaunt across worlds, relive one of the defining moments of Gielinor's history, and prepare to find out what will happen when Zaros and Zamorak finally meet again.

name: City of Senntisten
description: The Elder Gods' eggs are on the verge of hatching. Something must be done.

name: Clock Tower
description: Help the confused Brother Kojo find the missing cogs and fix his [this quest]. Search the dungeon using brawn and brains to correctly place the four cogs.

name: Cold Front
description: The Queen is snowed under. It's been years since she last presided over the great snow tournament, and after months of planning and anticipation, she can accept nothing less than perfection.

name: Cold War
description: At Ardougne Zoo, a zookeeper obsessed - borderline paranoid - about penguins needs your help observing their behaviour on an iceberg in the Lunar Sea. What begins as a peaceful bird-watching expedition opens a new world of espionage and bad musicians.

name: Contact!
description: The High Priest of Icthlarin has problems again - this time with the inhabitants of Menaphos. Sophanem is recovering from the plague, yet most of its citizens are still trapped on the other side of the river. Diplomacy has failed and subterfuge beckons.

name: Cook's Assistant
description: The Lumbridge Castle cook needs ingredients to bake Duke Horacio's birthday cake.

name: Corporate Egg-spionage
description: Help the Easter Bunny manage a potentially hostile takeover.

name: Creature of Fenkenstrain
description: Dr Fenkenstrain, master and sole occupant of the castle to the north-east of Canifis, needs a new servant to go on a dark errand for him. Do you have the stomach (and other organs) to help Fenkenstrain pursue his twisted purpose?

name: Crocodile Tears
description: Crocodiles have been attacking more frequently and viciously of late. Work alongside Senliten and Leela to uncover the true cause and seek to amend it.

name: Curse of the Black Stone
description: Help Bryll Thoksdottir investigate a world-ending threat.

name: Daughter of Chaos
description: Journey into the Wilderness to investigate the Zamorakian civil war and track down Moia.|The quest icon on world map

name: Dead and Buried
description: Team up again with the Raptor for a tale of mazes, monsters, mahjarrat and masks.

name: Deadliest Catch
description: A huge fish has been terrorising the northern seas. Help a fisherman end the horror stories by catching beast!

name: Dealing with Scabaras
description: Once more there is intrigue afoot in Sophanem and the High Priest has been seeking out his bold adventurer contacts from the past. Mysterious corpses, ancient ruins and unscrupulous treasure-hunters all await if you accept his mission.

name: Death Plateau
description: Trolls have advanced from the north and are camped on [this quest], launching attacks against the principality of Burthorpe. The imperial guard suffer heavy losses. They need your help!

name: Death to the Dorgeshuun
description: Humans have visited the Dorgeshuun mines, but no cave goblin has surfaced since the signing of the Lumbridge-Dorgeshuun treaty. The council fears H.A.M. may plan another attack, and seeks an agent to investigate. But they do not want to send someone to the surface without a guide...

name: Defender of Varrock
description: Troubling reports are arriving from scouts in the Wilderness: zombies are amassing and organising. Zombies alone are incapable of such intelligent behaviour, and each time it has happened in the past great tragedies have come to pass. Captain Rovin, suitably concerned, needs your help to go on a dangerous mission to verify the reports. Are the Varrock Guard just being paranoid, or could this be a major threat to their city? Reading the Legend of Arrav in the Lores and Histories section of the website will give you a better appreciation of the storyline of this quest.

name: Demon Slayer
description: Prevent a Zamorakian wizard from completing a demonic ritual.

name: Desert Treasure
description: An archaeologist has discovered clues to a hoard of treasure hidden deep in the desert, south of Al-Kharid. Assisting him could yield a substantial, ancient reward.

name: Desperate Creatures
description: Kerapac's machinations on Anachronia have resulted in strange natural phenomena. Help the Curator investigate them.

name: Desperate Measures
description: Seren needs help stopping Kerapac from wiping out all life on Gielinor.

name: Desperate Times
description: Seren needs help finding a solution to the elder god threat.

name: Devious Minds
description: No one likes to miss a good ceremony; least of all a poor lowly monk who needs your assistance! Will you aid him and make his dreams come true?

name: Diamond in the Rough
description: Prince Ali has been kidnapped and it's up to you and Ozan to rescue him. Follow a trail through the desert led by a diamond with rather interesting properties to confront Prince Ali's kidnappers.

name: Dimension of Disaster
description: Discover what would happen to Varrock in a world without you.

name: Dishonour among Thieves
description: Zamorak is gathering a team of agents to take part in a dangerous raid.

name: Do No Evil
description: Help re-establish a simian society in an unlikely locale.

name: Dragon Slayer
description: Prove yourself a true hero. Kill the mighty dragon Elvarg of Crandor to join the Champions' Guild.

name: Dream Mentor
description: Gielinor teems with perilous dragons, trolls, demons and other dangerous monsters. In this quest, you aid an adventurer that struggles against these surmountable threats. But can you defeat the monsters in your dreams and deepest fears? A challenging and strange quest awaits those with a strong will.

name: Druidic Ritual
description: The druids have decided to join the defence of Taverley and Burthorpe, and they're looking to get their god on their side. By concocting a potion with the help of their herbal specialist, you'll gain Guthix's favour and send the trolls packing.

name: Duck Quest
description: Help a lost little duckling find her family.

name: Dwarf Cannon
description: For years, the dwarven black guard have advanced projectile warfare. Constantly attacked by goblin renegades, the dwarven troops who protect the mines must deploy their secret weapon. Only with your aid can they harness the true power of this cannon!

name: Eadgar's Ruse
description: Sanfew requires a rare herb for the next part of the purifying ritual. Return to the troll stronghold to find their favourite dish's key ingredient.

name: Eagles' Peak
description: The Ardougne Zoo seeks new specimens, but the northern ferret has proven elusive. An eccentric freelance specimen hunter went west for it, but nothing more has been heard from him. Can you track him down? What else will you discover in the mountains of [this quest]?

name: Eclipse of the Heart
description: At the end of Beneath Scabaras’ Sands, Amascut issued an ultimatum: surrender the last light of Tumeken before the new moon, or Menaphos will fall into darkness. That moment has arrived—the eclipse has begun, and her army stands ready to strike. To stop her, you must rally the four lesser gods, navigate ancient puzzle-filled tombs, and uncover the key to defeating the Goddess of Destruction once and for all. As the story unfolds, several returning characters will receive visual updates, including Amascut, who will regain her divine form—setting the stage for a climactic final showdown between you and the goddess herself. The fate of Menaphos hangs in the balance—are you ready to face the eclipse?|{{UD|RS Ahead at RuneFest - Havenhythe, Leagues and More Revealed!

name: Elemental Workshop I
description: Centuries ago, a mineral was discovered that could absorb, transform, or focus magic. Fearing its impact, magicians sealed this workshop. Can you re-discover the lost knowledge of elemental ore and puzzle out its machinery?

name: Elemental Workshop II
description: Unravel the mysteries of body energy in the Elemental Workshop!

name: Elemental Workshop III
description: A restored text in the Seers' Village chapel stands apart. Within, Vitruvius' story continues, as he attempts to restore his assistant with the mysterious properties of the 'body'. Lessons await in this new book, as you again practice the theories of Vitruvius. Only those skilled in solving complex puzzles may unlock the workshop's latest secret.

name: Elemental Workshop IV
description: Decipher the conundrums of the chaotic cosmos in the Elemental Workshop!

name: Enakhra's Lament
description: Lazim the sculptor has a sad tale to tell - his days of making art are over, and now all he can do is scold adventurers crafting his statue in the desert. Assist Lazim with his artistic endeavours, and uncover deeper Kharidian history than you'd imagine.

name: Enlightened Journey
description: On the tranquil island of Entrana, a solitary monk yearns for adventure. Auguste seeks to boldly write his name in the history books; to craftily defeat the laws of physics; to miraculously sail through the air...and preferably not horribly explode in a ball of flaming death.

name: Ernest the Chicken
description: Veronica is very worried. Her fiancé went into the big spooky manor house to ask for directions. An hour later and he's still not out yet.

name: Evil Dave's Big Day Out
description: Evil Dave needs your help conjuring a spell that will finally impress Zamorak.

name: Extinction
description: Help the alliance of the gods solve the problem of the Elder God eggs once and for all.

name: Eye of Het I
description: The Duel Arena has been destroyed! Icthlarin needs your help to recover a relic hidden within.

name: Eye of Het II
description: The Duel Arena has been destroyed! Icthlarin needs your help to work out how it happened.

name: Family Crest
description: The Fitzharmon [this quest] is missing, and the family's honour is at stake. Return the crest to Dimintheis in Varrock, and claim one of three rewards.

name: Fate of the Gods
description: Determine Zaros's fate as he attempts to return to Gielinor.

name: Field of Screams
description: Try to join The Horsemen by reminding Gielinor of the tricks and treats of Halloween.

name: Fight Arena
description: The notorious General Khazard has abducted {{Sic|tThe

name: Fishing Contest
description: The mountain dwarves' home offers a safe route across White Wolf Mountain. However, they aren't fond of strangers. Austri and Vestri will grant passage through their tunnel if you bring them the Hemenster fishing competition trophy.

name: Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf
description: The Red Axe Mining Company has departed Keldagrim and set up headquarters in a remote underground location. Veldaban, the commander of the Black Guard, asks you to investigate whether the Red Axe pose a nefarious threat. The sole lead in the case is an extremely drunken and kebab-obsessed dwarf.

name: Forgiveness of a Chaos Dwarf
description: A message from an unknown benefactor leads Veldaban to strike against a forgotten threat.

name: Fur 'n Seek
description: Now he's got some body, the Odd Old Man wants you to give him some skin. The animals aren't so fluffy this time.

name: Garden of Tranquillity
description: Queen of Varrock seeks experienced gardener to create serene garden as surprise for husband. Only serious farmers need apply. Peasants welcome (although not that welcome). Tools not supplied.

name: Gertrude's Cat
description: [this quest] is missing; she's very worried. Can you rescue her prized pet? Herding cats is challenging. They get hungry and need plenty of attention. If you're a pet lover, this is the quest for you!

name: Ghosts Ahoy
description: The citizens of Port Phasmatys are doomed to eternal ghosthood. Necrovarus, lord of the temple of Phasmatys, holds the key to the next world. Will you persuade him to open the door and set them free?

name: Glorious Memories
description: See old friends in new ways as you delve into their past and help them settle their differences.

name: Goblin Diplomacy
description: There's a disturbance in the Goblin Village. Help the goblins solve their dispute so the world doesn't have to worry about rioting goblins.

name: Gower Quest
description: Help the Gower brothers uncover the mystery of the disappearing cabbages.

name: Great Egg-spectations
description: Work with the Easter Bunny's niece to search for some new and egg-citing chocolate ideas for the Easter Bunny.

name: Grim Tales
description: Sylas, a collector of wondrous and unusual items, seeks new additions to his trove, offering an unusual prize. Terrors and towers, fierce battles with giant beasts, and a daring rescue a dwarf in distress await. Not a quest for the meek or faint-hearted. Brace yourself for a feast of fairytale fun!

name: Gunnar's Ground
description: Help a love-sick dwarf pursue the unlikely object of his affections!

name: Guys and Dolls
description: Help Guy and Doyle add a few more colours to the Harvest Hollow.

name: Haunted Mine
description: Recent forays into Morytania by some of Saradomin's more fanatical supporters have unearthed murky rumours concerning an abandoned mine in the south. Legend suggests an unusual substance deep within, linked to the desolation and dread that surrounds it. Do you possess the courage to enter the [this quest]s of Morytania?

name: Hazeel Cult
description: Uncover the secrets of the Carnillean family fortune. Choose to aid the Carnilleans in retrieving stolen goods, or join the [this quest] in resurrecting the infamous Lord Hazeel.

name: Heart of Stone
description: Help Ariane to track down an old friend turned rogue.

name: Hearts of Sanguine
description: Investigate rumours of a mysterious woman who recently arrived in Wendlewick.

name: Heartstealer
description: It's Caelyn and Annette's third wedding anniversary tomorrow. Will you help Caelyn obtain the perfect gift?

name: Heralds of Crimson
description: Prepare for (and deal with) the arrival of the Ghrazi Blood Knights.

name: Hermit Permits
description: Help the villagers of Wendlewick with a crab problem.

name: Hero's Welcome
description: Deal with the arrival of V and the consequences of his return to Rellekka.

name: Heroes' Quest
description: You will first have to prove you are worthy to enter the Heroes' Guild. To prove your status as a hero, you will need to obtain a number of items. There are many challenges standing between you and these items.

name: Holy Grail
description: King Arthur sends his knights on a quest for the [this quest]. If you are a Knight of the Round Table, go to King Arthur for instructions.

name: Horror from the Deep
description: The lighthouse protecting Kandarin's north-western coastline has mysteriously ceased operation, and communication with the lighthouse-keeper Jossik is lost. The council urgently seeks to know what happened to this most vital edifice.

name: Housing of Parliament
description: Help Deryn the owl keeper to spruce up the owlery, and entice the owls back to Um.

name: Hunt for Red Raktuber
description: There are penguins and a submarine. What more do you need to know?

name: Icthlarin's Little Helper
description: In the southern desert, unrest is brewing. The menaphites have barred their city's gates. An unsettling desert wanderer may hold the secret to entering Sophanem - the city of the dead. Enter into a titanic struggle for the soul of the High Priest of Icthlarin in a land where the cat is top dog.

name: Imp Catcher
description: Wizard Grayzag has summoned hundreds of little imps. They have stolen a lot of things belonging to Wizard Mizgog, including his magic beads.

name: Impressing the Locals
description: Assemble a crew for Stan's new ship - Sarim's Revenge - and prepare to set sail for the Wushanko Isles!

name: In Aid of the Myreque
description: After Vanstrom Klause's attack on the Myreque and the deaths of Sani and Harold, Veliaf counts on your aid. Their base is compromised; they must relocate. An obscure village south of Mort'ton may be the perfect location to strike back against their vampyric overlords. What dark secrets of Morytania's past will you uncover?

name: In Pyre Need
description: An ancient avian of fiery disposition is in need of your help! By chance, a priest with a suspicious amount of knowledge about the phoenix has appeared near its roost, and seeks an adventurer with the skills and the mettle to venture forth and aid the phoenix in its hour of need.

name: In Search of the Myreque
description: A stranger in Canifis seeks help. He aims to track down some local heroes known only as the Myreque. Search for and provide them with weapons in their desperate battle against the darkness of Morytania.

name: It's Snow Bother
description: Team up with Santa and the snow imps to help restore Christmas spirit to the main cities of the world.

name: Jungle Potion
description: Trufitus Shakaya of the Tai Bwo Wannai Village requires that you collect five special jungle herbs for a potion so he can commune with his gods.

name: Kennith's Concerns
description: Strange happenings stir in the slug-riddled village of Witchaven. Kennith, the child you rescued, is convinced the peaceful (though gastropod-possessed) locals are up to something sinister in the caverns beneath. Beware: appearances can deceive.

name: Kili Row
description: Introduce yourself to the City of Um's smith, and learn how to perform ensoul rituals.

name: Kindred Spirits
description: Linza needs your help to investigate several kidnappings that have occurred across Gielinor, including the kidnapping of none other than Sliske himself. Also you'll learn secrets about the mysterious Barrows brothers, secrets that they haven't even told one another.

name: King of the Dwarves
description: Help the dwarven capital through a crisis and find the long-lost heir to its throne.

name: King's Ransom
description: Since,{{sic

name: Land of the Goblins
description: The most ancient goblin legends speak of Yu'biusk, the far-off land that saw the origin of the goblin race. Now, one goblin has had a vision of this land and believes it is Zanik's destiny to lead all goblins to live there in peace and safety - but Zanik will not be able to realise her destiny without your help.

name: Learning the Ropes
description: Begin your adventure in Gielinor.

name: Legacy of Seergaze
description: Drezel uncovers a dark secret beneath Paterdomus linked to Morytania's brutal past. What lies ahead for young Safalaan and the Myreque? Will they uncover new secrets, and can they resist the vyrewatch before House Drakan's hunger targets Misthalin?

name: Legends' Quest
description: Accept the challenge of the Legends' Guild to map the southern part of Karamja, make friends with the natives and bring back a prize to display in the hall of legends.

name: Let Them Eat Pie
description: The poor people of Burthorpe face attacks from within and without, as they slowly starve due to food shortages. Yet, there are vegetables in the fields and stock on the shelves, so why aren't the poverty-struck getting their fair share? Investigate and make sure that bellies are filled in a quest that will sicken you to your stomach.

name: Lost City
description: Legends tell of a magical [this quest] hidden in the swamps. Many adventurers have tried to find this city, but it is proving difficult. Can you unlock the secrets of the city of Zanaris?

name: Love Story
description: The Wise Old man's past comes back to haunt him - and you!

name: Lunar Diplomacy
description: Prepare for a diplomatic mission between the Fremennik and the enigmatic Moon Clan of Lunar Isle. Resolve their conflict and restore peace. Travel with pirates on a mighty galleon, explore a magical island and venture into your very dreams!

name: Making History
description: A secluded outpost has served the City of Ardougne for generations, playing stage to many exceptional events. Its current occupant wants to employ your skills to construct its true history before time runs out and history itself is wiped away!

name: Meeting History
description: Jorral has discovered more information about the weird yet wonderful enchanted key. Where this historical information will lead is a mystery, but one thing is certain: it'll be no ordinary search for clues from the past.

name: Merlin's Crystal
description: Merlin the wizard is imprisoned in a giant crystal. Take up King Arthur's quest to free Merlin and become a Knight of the Round Table.

name: Missing My Mummy
description: The desert sands rarely offer up their treasures, but when they do it is sure to be of interest to those with pure intentions and those with gold in their eyes. Leela, Osman's agent in Draynor, has heard that a new pyramid has been unearthed, and that secrets from the days before the God Wars may well be due some time in the open air...

name: Missing, Presumed Death
description: When a group of Saradominist monks are slaughtered by an unknown assailant you are asked by the only survivor - a monk who is extremely traumatised - to find the killer and bring them to justice. But there's more to this puzzle than meets the eye, starting with the souls of the dead monks being trapped in their bodies...

name: Monk's Friend
description: A child's blanket has been stolen! Find the thieves' den, return the blanket, and help Brother Omad organise drinks for the child's birthday party.

name: Monkey Madness
description: Narnode Shareen, king of the gnome stronghold, once again needs your help. He sent an envoy of his royal guard, the 10th squad, to oversee the decommissioning of ship-building facilities on Karamja's eastern coast. They have been deemed missing in action. Can you unravel the mystery behind their disappearance and discern fact from fiction?

name: Mountain Daughter
description: A small tribe split from the Fremennik in Rellekka now inhabits the mountains to the east. The chieftain of the nomads has lost his daughter and refuses to move camp until she is found. Whether she ran away, was eaten by trolls, or worse, is a mystery only you can solve.

name: Mourning's End Part I
description: It seems at last Arianwyn has need of your skills. He suspects there's more to the mourners than meets the eye, and he wants you to uncover their true intentions. Can you earn the trust of the mourners?

name: Mourning's End Part II
description: This chapter takes our hero deep under the mountains of Arandar to thwart the evil plans of the mourners. To succeed, they must solve one of the most complicated puzzles in all of Gielinor.

name: Murder Mystery
description: Lord Sinclair, an esteemed Kandarin noble, has been murdered in his mansion. Local law enforcement are baffled. Can you apply your sharp analytical mind to uncover the evidence and discover the culprit?

name: Murder on the Border
description: To celebrate your construction of Fort Forinthry, host a banquet for the royalty and nobility of Misthalin. What could go wrong?

name: My Arm's Big Adventure
description: Trolls adore goutweed, but they've devoured it all. Burntmeat the cook has heard how to cultivate it. Can you teach his young assistant, My Arm, to farm this valuable plant? Will you overcome My Arm's stubbornness and ignorance? Get ready for a distinctly trollish expedition.

name: Myths of the White Lands
description: Explorer Jack may have taken a break from exploring, but his constant search for myths that could hold secrets to rare trinkets and other trophies has led him to a snow imp, who told him a tale of riches in the distant Land of Snow. He now wants you to verify whether the imp's story holds truth.

name: Nature Spirit
description: Having rescued Drezel, the holy man again seeks your aid. Brave the terrors of Mort Myre swamp in search of an implausibly named druid.

name: Necromancy!
description: Start your journey as a friend of the undead, in a bid to curtail a threat from Gielinor's very first necromancer.

name: New Foundations
description: King Roald is offering you a duchy and all the problems that come with it.

name: Nomad's Elegy
description: Foil Nomad's dastardly scheme with the help of Death and Icthlarin.

name: Nomad's Requiem
description: A dark figure looms with mysterious intent. Find out what he's up to and stop it!

name: Observatory Quest
description: The observatory in south-west Ardougne has been ransacked by local goblins. Can you help the professors to rebuild it?

name: Ode of the Devourer
description: Investigate and put a stop to the soul devourer curse plaguing the Kharidian Desert.

name: Olaf's Quest
description: Poor Olaf Hradson has to live up to such expectations. His ancestors sailed all over the world; now he must prove himself their equal. If only he could read a map, sail, or avoid crashing. Can you help a dejected and soggy Fremennik restore his pride and recover his grandfather's lost treasure?

name: Once Upon a Slime
description: King Slime has returned. Will you help Peter to eliminate the threat?

name: Once Upon a Time in Gielinor
description: Celebrate your life as an adventurer!

name: One of a Kind
description: Mr Mordaut, an avid draconic historian, has uncovered recent journal entries revealing the fate of Hannibus, the last dragon rider. Discovering Hannibus alive would be momentous, offering insight into their past, and hope that Hannibus' calming influence could help dragons put aside their rage and differences and potentially unify as a species.

name: One Piercing Note
description: Solve a brutal murder and restore harmony to the Abbey of Saint Elspeth.

name: One Small Favour
description: Yanni has a small favour to ask of you. Nothing particularly large or demanding, and it should hardly take you any time at all. Just something to do when you have a spare moment.

name: Osseous Rex
description: Investigate the mystery of Osseous.

name: Our Man in the North
description: Hassan feels now is a good time to report back to Emir Ali and Osman, plus don't forget that book Osman requested from Menaphos's Grand Library...

name: Perils of Ice Mountain
description: The dwarven miners have built an engineering marvel: a machine that automatically manufactures pickaxes, powered by a new station on the slopes of Ice Mountain. Meanwhile, a hapless dwarf delivering resources to the power station has lost part of his delivery and any adventurer who helps him is bound to find more problems to solve.

name: Pharaoh's Folly
description: Picking up right after Beneath Scabaras' Sands, you'll return to Menaphos to join Ozan and Leela in exposing Pharaoh Osman's treachery. With the fate of the city hanging in the balance, it's up to you to rally the ruling council against Amascut. In this quest, you'll revisit the shifting tombs, uncover Menaphite lore, and delve into the long history of desert quests to build your case and confront Osman once and for all.||{{CiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/rs-ahead-at-runefest---havenhythe-leagues-and-more-revealed|author=The Runescape Team|title=RS Ahead at RuneFest - Havenhythe, Leagues and More Revealed!|newsdate=1 March 2025

name: Pieces of Hate
description: Rabid Jack's hatred of the pirate isles has come to a head. Can you stop the madness?

name: Pirate's Treasure
description: Redbeard Frank knows where secret pirate treasure is hidden. It may require some work to persuade him to let you know where, though.

name: Plague City
description: Episode 1 of our multi-part quest. A shadow of disease has overcast Ardougne. Edmond's {{sic|daugher

name: Plague's End
description: End the plague of West Ardougne and gain entry to the elf city of Prifddinas.

name: Priest in Peril
description: Contact with the Temple of Paterdomus on Misthalin's eastern border has been lost. King Roald urgently seeks an adventurer to investigate and report back to him.

name: Princess and the Pauper
description: Help Princess solve the mystery of Chef Rodney's missing ingredients!

name: Quiet Before the Swarm
description: Rumours of pest sightings on the mainland have reached the ears of the Void Knights. Has a pest managed to slip defences?

name: Rag and Bone Man
description: Everybody needs some body, and the Odd Old Man knows exactly which bits of those bodies he needs. Can you help him finish his extensive and extremely creepy collection?

name: Raksha, the Shadow Colossus (quest)
description: Venture beneath the ruins of Orthen with Laniakea to find the beast known as Raksha.

name: Rat Catchers
description: Gertrude knows of some [this quest] in Varrock. Visit her to learn their whereabouts. They'll teach you and your cat a few pointers about catching rats. Explore the subterranean world of the [this quest] and unlock your cat's potential.

name: Recipe for Disaster
description: The cook in Lumbridge has surprisingly few ingredients to hand in his kitchen (possibly due to an endless stream of newcomers with light fingers). A cook's assistant kindly aided him in his culinary duties, but a problem has now arisen that could spell... a [this quest]!

name: Recruitment Drive
description: The Temple Knights, a secretive organisation founded by Saradomin centuries ago, seek to expand their ranks with some new blood. You will be offered an opportunity to apply for membership in this covert order. Are you up to the challenge?

name: Regicide
description: Continuing the Plague City series, this quest takes you beyond the Well of Voyage to a new realm. King Lathas hires you for the grim task of deposing his brother. Travelling into Tirranwn, you'll encounter strange flora, fauna and even a new race. However, all is not as serene as it first appears.

name: Remains of the Necrolord
description: Learn more about Rasial from a previous student of his in Daemonheim.

name: Requiem for a Dragon
description: Uncover the nature of the curse afflicting Vorkath's soul and lay him to rest.

name: Ritual of the Mahjarrat
description: The planets have aligned, signalling the [this quest]. If he becomes rejuvenated, with an arsenal of weapons taken from the gods themselves, will you be able to stop Lucien achieving total dominance?

name: River of Blood
description: The seventh and final instalment in the Myreque quest series.

name: Rocking Out
description: What do zombies, pirates, monks and evil plots have in common? Well, if you want to find out, it's time to start digging! Rabid Jack is back...but who is he? It's time to prove your pirate credentials and win the trust of the motleyest crew. Dark and nautical secrets are yours to discover...if you dare!

name: Roving Elves
description: Deep in Isafdar's elven forests live a duo of [this quest]: Islwyn (a grumpy, old elf who dislikes humans), and Eluned (a friendly, young elf with a kind heart). Overcome Islwyn's prejudice against humans and ease the burdens of the past.

name: Royal Trouble
description: Being regent of a small island kingdom is tough, especially when the King declared war while you were away. Something's amiss in Miscellania and Etceteria. Better find out before both kingdoms end up in [this quest]!

name: Rum Deal
description: Zombie pirates have seized Braindeath Island, and are anything but friendly. 'Rum' production has stopped, and pirate brewers are panicking. Can you overcome the horde of drunken, undead pirates? Can you even reach the island without a pounding headache?

name: Rune Mechanics
description: Apprentice Clerval at the Mage Training Arena is just a bit useless, which really isn't helping him to achieve his dream of being the first wizard in centuries to build a rune guardian from scratch. He might need some help to do some research, gather supplies, fix broken machinery, and, er, do everything else.

name: Rune Memories
description: Ariane is in a bit of a bind, and needs your help once more. Explore the arcane ruins beneath the Wizards' Tower, experience the memories of its former inhabitants, and you'll learn the clashes of magical ideals that led to the old tower's downfall. Piece together the ancient puzzle to free Ariane and avert the disaster once and for all.

name: Rune Mysteries
description: Ariane knows that the Wizards' Tower is under threat but no one wants to believe her. Aid Ariane in her efforts to protect the Wizards' Tower and discover just what's going on.

name: Rune Mythos
description: Learn of some of the origins of necromantic magic, and how to craft runes and cast incantations.

name: Salt in the Wound
description: Time to rescue the residents of Witchaven from their mis-guided 'enlightenment'. A solution to the sea-slug infestation has finally been found. It's up to you to lead a crack team of slug-slaying soldiers into battle against this slimy foe.

name: Scorpion Catcher
description: Thormac's rare lesser-kharid scorpions escaped when he left their cage door open, and they're hidden in hard-to-reach places. To catch his scorptions, you'll overcome various challenges - and drink a lot of beer. If you succeed, Thormac will improve your battlestaves.

name: Sea Slug
description: Unusual activity on the Fishing Platform: missing fishermen and dozens of strange sea creatures are cause for concern. Investigate the platform and discover the truth before it's too late.

name: Secrets of Amberfell
description: Continue your journey into Havenhythe by helping to reconnect the settlements of Wendlewick and Amberfell.|In-game calendar

name: Shades of Mort'ton
description: Mort Myre's southern border has been breached, revealing a route to the strange town of Mort'ton. Strangers return with tales of the 'afflicted' and shadowy guardians of tomb treasure.

name: Shadow of the Storm
description: A sinister group of dark wizards aims to summon Agrith-Naar, a demon of exceptional mystical power. A Saradominist priest seeks help to summon the demon and then kill it once and for all. But all is not as it seems...

name: Sheep Herder
description: Rumours are circulating of plague-infected sheep escaping into East Ardougne. They must be found and eradicated to prevent an outbreak.

name: Shield of Arrav
description: Varrockian literature tells of a valuable shield, stolen long ago from the Museum of Varrock, by a gang of professional thieves.

name: Shilo Village
description: A mysterious village has been discovered deep in southern Karamja's jungle. Who knows what treasures or supernatural terrors lie in wait for daring explorers?

name: Sins of the Father
description: Discover the effigy incubator.

name: Sliske's Endgame
description: Since the death of Guthix, Sliske has put god against god in a game where the winner takes the Stone of Jas. Now [this quest] is finally here and a winner will be crowned.

name: Smoking Kills
description: Pollnivneach has a new resident. Who is this mysterious stranger, and how did her sister become trapped in a Slayer dungeon{{Sic

name: Some Like It Cold
description: Teddy - an agent of the PBJ - has gone missing while on the trail to find Larry. Chuck has received a ransom note from the Walrus and has asked you to investigate. Become a roadie for the famous Ping and Pong and break into a PoW camp to save Larry.

name: Song from the Depths
description: The men of Rimmington have entered a deep sleep. Help save them from their shared dreams.

name: Soul Searching
description: Investigate a mysterious spirit hanging around Um.

name: Spirit of Summer
description: The ghost of a small girl has appeared at the farm ruins in the Wilderness. There seems to be something she wants, but she is too weak to communicate properly. Can you figure out what needs to be done?

name: Spirits of the Elid
description: The villagers of Nardah have a problem. Their town well is dry and any water they take from the river mysteriously vanishes. They believe they are cursed. Can you unravel the truth and save Nardah?

name: Stellar Born
description: Help a stranded star sprite get back to their home planet.

name: Stolen Hearts
description: Ozan's in Draynor Village, looking for an old friend who's fallen into bad company. You'll join Ozan as you infiltrate the Draynor underworld, meet an old flame, and become caught up in a kidnapping plot of princely proportions that leads back to Al Kharid - the home from which Ozan was banished years ago.

name: Succession
description: Venture deep into the Wilderness with Adrasteia for one last adventure before her coronation.|In-game description

name: Summer's End
description: The spirit beast is threatening to tear its way into our world, so Summer and her family need your help to stop it once and for all. You must once more venture into the spirit beast's realm and, together with the elders, take on the beast to save them.

name: Swan Song
description: The Piscatoris Fishing Colony is under attack by angry sea trolls, hindering monkfish harvests. The colony's director seeks an experienced adventurer to eliminate the trolls, and has his eye on the morally dubious Wise Old Man (who alleged involvement in the Draynor bank robbery remains unproven). Join the him on his his final adventure.

name: Swept Away
description: Maggie the travelling witch is cooking up something spectacular in her cauldron, but she needs a little help finishing it off. If you can help her out - and solve a puzzle or two along the way - she just might share some of the final product with you.

name: Tai Bwo Wannai Trio
description: In 'Jungle Potion', shaman Trufitus communed with the gods to determine his people's fate. Now, Tai Bwo Wannai's chief, Timfraku, seeks to restore his village and family. Help a depressed fisherman, encourage a raging hunter and satiate an eccentric priest in this extreme test of aptitude and patience!

name: Tears of Guthix (quest)
description: Deep beneath the earth, Juna the serpent has guarded the tears of Guthix for three thousand years. If adventurers can relieve her boredom with an entertaining story, she will allow them into the cave to collect the tears. First, she requires completion of a short task.

name: Temple of Ikov
description: A mysterious stranger named Lucien sends you on a mission deep under the [this quest] in central Kandarin to retrieve an artefact. Will you entrust the Staff of Armadyl to Lucien?

name: That Old Black Magic
description: Help the Dead Beats to reform their band, to bring back the City of Um's vibe.

name: The Blood Pact
description: Descend into ancient catacombs and confront a cult threatening to sacrifice an innocent prisoner.

name: The Branches of Darkmeyer
description: An unexpected ally reveals details of a source of power against the vampyres, but do you have the courage to retrieve it?

name: The Brink of Extinction
description: The continued survival of the TzHaar race hangs in the balance. Lead a second expedition into the Elder Kiln, where the TzHaar hope to resurrect their greatest warriors by fusing them painfully with the Ga'al.

name: The Chosen Commander
description: Discover the truth behind a friend's destiny and take part in the cave goblins' last stand.

name: The Curse of Arrav
description: In the mysterious icy waste to the north of troll country, uncover more of the mysteries of the Mahjarrat and learn about the dark magic that was used to enslave Arrav these last few millennia.

name: The Darkness of Hallowvale
description: The Myreque have relocated to Burgh de Rott. Veliaf tasks you with infiltrating the Sanguinesti region. What grim discoveries lie beyond that dread wall? Will you be spared the blood tithe of a vyrewatch? Only a quick-witted and sharp-eyed agent can hope to navigate the slums of Meiyerditch.

name: The Death of Chivalry
description: Infiltrate the Black Knight's Fortress in search of a mysterious weapon hidden since the God Wars.

name: The Dig Site
description: Join students at [this quest] and become qualified in making the earth move. Do you have what it takes to excavate a buried altar dedicated to one of Gielinor's lesser-known gods?

name: The Elder Kiln
description: TzHaar eggs are hatching into Ga'al - TzHaar without inborn memories needed to perform their traditional caste roles. Travel with one of these Ga'al to search for a way to bestow these memories upon him, unearthing the secrets of the TzHaar race.

name: The Eyes of Glouphrie
description: After you thwarted a plan to destroy the Grand Tree, Brimstail discovered a confusing machine engineered by Oaknock during the gnomish golden age. What is its purpose? Why was it constructed? Help the gnome operate his device, learn a little about gnomish magic and history, and begin to uncover a hidden and sinister threat to gnome security.

name: The Feud
description: Ali Morrisane, Al Kharid's self proclaimed 'greatest merchant', is seemingly suffering from success, struggling to keep his stall stocked due to strong sales. He's seeking someone to recruit help from his home town, Pollnivneach.

name: The Firemaker's Curse
description: A group of adventurers needs your help to guide them through a foreboding cavern, but a simple excursion soon turns into an underground nightmare.

name: The Fremennik Isles
description: Sibling rivalry turns vicious when Fremennik princes clash. The islands of Jatizso and Neitiznot, founded by sworn enemies, remain at odds. Now, a threat from trolls in the north endangers both islands. Can you prove your loyalty, save the islanders and prove your skills as a warrior, builder and a jester?

name: The Fremennik Trials
description: Council workmen have finally repaired the footbridge connecting Kandarin and Rellekka. Impress the barbarians and earn their respect an honorary member of their clan.

name: The Giant Dwarf
description: Five hundred years ago, King Alvis, founder of the Consortium and saviour turned victim, ruled Keldagrim. Today, the monarchy is a distant memory. Only the statue of King Alvis reminds the people of the old days; the dark days. So begins the Rise of the Red Axe.

name: The Golem
description: In the desert ruins of the once great city of Uzer, a lone survivor - an ancient clay golem - paces forever. Badly damaged, its mind cannot rest until it has completed the task for which it was created. Uncover the Uzer's secret, and add the final chapter to a story begun in the violence of the Third Age.

name: The Grand Tree
description: [this quest], which shelters the tree gnomes, is dying. Is it human sabotage or an inside job? Help King Shareen uncover the truth and save the gnomes from an uncertain fate.

name: The Great Brain Robbery
description: {{Sic|he

name: The Hand in the Sand
description: Bert the sandman in Yanille is in a spot of bother. A mysterious severed hand has appeared in his sand box. Help find out whose hand it is and, more to the point, how it got in Bert's sand box.

name: The Jack of Spades
description: The Pharaoh of Menaphos has extended an invitation to Emir Ali to send an envoy to the Golden City to discuss terms of a new trade agreement, and cement peace between the two cities.

name: The Knight's Sword
description: Sir Vyvin's squire has accidentally lost the knight's ceremonial sword. Help him discreetly find a replacement.

name: The Light Within
description: Aid the elves in their endeavour to restore their goddess Seren.

name: The Lord of Vampyrium
description: Kill Drakan!

name: The Lost Tribe
description: Sigmund advises the Duke of Lumbridge, though the Duke does not always take his advice. When the castle cellar wall collapses, the Duke claims an earthquake; Sigmund suspects a monster attack. Investigating reveals a perilous journey through treacherous caves to uncover something lost by the gods for millennia.

name: The Mighty Fall
description: Help the fractured Bandosian forces choose a new leader after Bandos' death at the claws of Armadyl.

name: The Needle Skips
description: Unravel the mystery of the Needle and discover the events that led to a strange murder.

name: The Path of Glouphrie
description: King Bolren has a new pet. Unfortunately, it's another watcher. Has Glouphrie been watching the tree gnome village, too? If you investigate further, you'll find out more about Glouphrie, the history of the gnomes (and their unusual monarchy) and maybe you'll get within a hair's breadth of the lost city of Arposandra...

name: The Prisoner of Glouphrie
description: An old letter leads you to Lletya in the company of a gnome mother, along a path that no human - and only one gnome - has ever trodden. You'll encounter Yewnock's most ingenious calibration device to date, and gain rare insight into Arposandra as you investigate the fate of Glouphrie's prisoner.

name: The Restless Ghost
description: A ghost haunts Lumbridge cemetery and the priest of Lumbridge church of Saradomin needs your help to lay the ghost to rest.

name: The Slug Menace
description: Darkness stirs in Witchaven. A secret sleeps beneath this once prosperous fishing village. Why do the villagers act so oddly? What transformed Mayor Hobb? Will Ezekial Lovecraft ever find a friend? Before a lurking menace unleashes destruction on the world, these questions must be answered.

name: The Spirit of War
description: Convince the Boatman to ferry you to Rasial's citadel, then face off against Hermod, [this quest].

name: The Tale of the Muspah
description: Join Erjolf in his quest for a trophy, unravel the puzzling story behind a curious corpse, and discover the dark secrets of one of the most fearsome races ever to walk in Gielinor.

name: The Temple at Senntisten
description: Ali the Wise discussed your various dealings with the Mahjarrat with one of his 'old friends' - a certain Dr Nabanik. The good doctor thinks you would be the perfect candidate to aid him in his restoration of the temple beneath the dig site. But for what purpose? And who is this enigmatic Dr Nabanik?

name: The Tourist Trap
description: South of Al Kharid, a desert pass opens to the perilous Kharidian desert. Don your desert garb and fill your waterskins before venturing into the trackless dunes in search of adventure.

name: The Vault of Shadows
description: Dr Nabanik has a newfound urgency for uncovering one of Kharid-et's biggest secrets.

name: The Void Stares Back
description: Confront the mastermind behind the pests on the mainland, and send them back where they came from!

name: The World Wakes
description: A museum archaelogist has made a potentially ground-breaking discovery. Join him to explore ancient caverns, fight legendary warriors, and become part of the most important event for thousands of years.

name: There's No Place Like Home...
description: Get your hands on some real estate and learn the basics of construction.

name: Throne of Miscellania
description: Rumours abound that all is not well in Miscellania. It is said that the king has been turned into a monster! An exceptional hero is required to investigate. Experience in ruling kingdoms, wooing royalty and negotiating peace would be an advantage.

name: TokTz-Ket-Dill
description: A creature inhabiting Karamja volcano has tunnelled beneath the TzHaar City, causing collapses and threatening their home. The proud TzHaar need your help. Can you navigate the quirks of TzHaar society and stabilise the tunnels to save their city?

name: Tomes of the Warlock
description: Learn more about Rasial from a series of tomes written by a previous student of his.

name: Tower of Life
description: The mysterious tower is nearly finished, but the builders are on strike. Frustrated, the alchemists seek help. When magic and logic collide, danger follows, yet a true adventurer may relish it.

name: Tree Gnome Village
description: The tree gnomes are under attack by General Khazard's forces. Navigate the hedge maze to their secret treetop village, then assist in fighting Khazard and retrieve the orbs of protection.

name: Tribal Totem
description: Lord Handelmort of Ardougne is a collector of exotic artefacts. A recent addition to his private collection is a strange looking totem from Karamja. The Rantuki Tribe are not happy about the recent disappearance of their totem.

name: Troll Romance
description: Ug loves Aga, but Aga is with Arrg, who is much stronger. Ug cannot follow the usual violent courtship. Can you discover what will impress the troll female more than a display of violence? Will you survive the journey to help a lonely troll find love?

name: Troll Stronghold
description: The imperial guard raid failed; Dunstan's son was captured by trolls. Traverse Trollheim and rescue him from the [this quest].

name: Twilight of the Gods
description: In the aftermath of the Elder God Wars, a wounded knight lies outside the doors that lead to Senntisten. What new threat awaits down in the darkness?

name: Underground Pass
description: The [this quest], sealed for thousands of years, has now been re-opened, revealing a complex labyrinth of tunnels and chasms. You must find a way through, and get one step closer to the evil King Tyras. But the road is long and it could be lonely. When fatigue starts to take its toll, mental strength is what you'll need...

name: Unwelcome Guests
description: Siv is concerned about Fort Forinthry's lack of security. Talk to her to find a solution.

name: Vampyre Slayer
description: The people of Draynor village live in constant terror. Their numbers are dwindling, all due to a foul creature known as a vampyre, lurking in the manor to the north.

name: Vessel of the Harbinger
description: Learn more about Rasial from a previous student of his in Port Phasmatys.

name: Violet is Blue
description: Journey to the Land of Snow and meet Violet...a young child with a dream.

name: Violet is Blue Too
description: An important snow imp has gone missing in the Land of Snow sending Yeti town into disaster with just two days left until Christmas.

name: Visions of Havenhythe
description: Discover the ancient and beautiful land of Havenhythe.

name: Wanted!
description: A wanted man is on the loose. Can you track him down?

name: Watchtower
description: The wizards of the Yanille [this quest] have recently reported increased ogre sightings. Use a wide variety of your skills to help the wizards recover their stolen power crystals and stop the advance of the ogre hordes!

name: Waterfall Quest
description: Investigate the death of elven leaders of old. Search for the elf King Baxtorian's tomb and discover the mysterious hidden treasure of the waterfall.

name: What Lies Below
description: A travelling trader is stranded south of Varrock after his cart was ambushed by outlaws. He seeks a hero to recover his lost documents, and more. The Varrock Palace Secret Guard (VPSG) investigate illicit dealings with the Monks of Zamorak. Can you assist them in discovering [this quest]?

name: What's Mine is Yours
description: Dwarven master smith Doric has fallen on hard times. He needs your help to rekindle his client list, avoid bankruptcy, and get to the bottom of an unscrupulous plot to undermine Doric's business.

name: While Guthix Sleeps
description: The craggy, bearded face of the druid shook with anger as he addressed his congregation: "How safe do you really feel? And are you happy to stand by while 'He' plans to make Gielinor his own?" The congregation murmured in apprehension. The druid continued, "I, for one, will no longer live in fear: we must act now!" There was a commotion outside, and soon a red-faced youth ran in, "Another murder...the tracker...he's been found!" ---- A power grows in the north, and an efficient spy network reports all that transpires to its master. The long, dark fear buried in the back of everyone's mind is starting to grow. That which was once overlooked has now become hard to ignore. For what nefarious purpose are there spies in Draynor? Exactly what is Movario looking for in the Lumbridge Swamp caves? What of the ancient power of the Mahjarrat and the dragonkin? Has something been missed? The ancient powers of the gods - where did it come from, and what would happen if a mortal could tap its power? Any interested parties should contact Radimus Erkle for what may prove to be the most challenging experience of their entire career.

name: Witch's House
description: A little boy has lost his ball in the garden of an unpleasant local witch.

name: Within the Light
description: A new disturbance has been sensed in the Temple of Light. Navigate to the temple's depths to locate the source of this energy, and you might find an unusual way of harnessing it.

name: Wiz Kid
description: Become a mentor to an aspiring young wizard.

name: Wolf Whistle
description: Help Pikkupstix find out what happened to his wayward apprentice.

name: You Are It
description: Can you survive where no other has? Learn the origins of clue scrolls in this quest.

name: Zogre Flesh Eaters
description: Run for your lives...the zombie ogres are here for your flesh! Their ancient ceremonial dance site is overrun with diseased undead ogres. How did this happen? And what rewards await an enterprising adventurer that explores these tombs?
